description: Permissions for the SecuraCV Flasher main window: open dialogs and external docs, and self-update. Deliberately NO shell permission: every espflash/rpiboot sidecar spawn happens Rust-side (launch_guard::spawn_tracked via ShellExt), which the webview capability system does not gate — so granting the webview shell:allow-execute (it used to, with args:true) only widened what an injected script could do, without being needed by anything. The frontend never calls plugin:shell.
